newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S-E-BANKEN SHARES FALL ON H1 REPORT.
newsitem.headline: S-E-BANKEN SHARES FALL ON H1 REPORT.

text.p: Shares in Swedish commercial bank S-E-Banken fell sharply after the bank reported a lower than expected six-month operating profit.
At 1100 GMT, the share price stood at 95.50 crowns after trading in a range between 98 and 98.5 ahead of the report. The Stockholm bourse's general index was up 0.2 percent.
"The profit was lower than expected and the bank also had increased costs for IT and marketing," one trader said.
S-E-Banken reported an operating profit after credit losses of 2.86 billion crowns, compared with market expectations of 3.02 billion.
